error.numbers_needed_exceed_capacity: Placing {num_users} users would need slot numbers up to {needed}, and lock {lock} has {num_slots} PIN code slots -- some of them already holding codes. Set up fewer users here, or manage the rest from a separate configuration. If the lock really does have more slots than that, re-interview it -- a stale or incomplete interview makes it under-report its capacity.
error.occupancy_unknown: Could not read the existing codes on {locks}. Lock Code Manager will not choose slot numbers it could not check, because one of them may already hold a code. Wake the lock or check it is reachable, then try again.
error.slot_name_not_unique: The name for code slot {slot_num} is already used by another code slot in this entry. Names must be unique.
error.slot_name_required: Code slot {slot_num} needs a name. The name identifies this user on your locks.
error.slot_out_of_range: Lock {lock} reports only {num_slots} PIN code slots, so these slot numbers are out of range for it: {out_of_range_slots}. Renumber them to fall within 1-{num_slots}, or manage that lock from a separate configuration. If the lock really does have more slots than that, re-interview it -- a stale or incomplete interview makes it under-report its capacity.
error.slots_already_configured: The following slots for lock {lock} are already managed by another config entry ({entry_title}) and can't be added to this configuration without being removed from the other one: {common_slots}
error.too_many_users: Lock {lock} has {num_slots} PIN code slots, so {num_users} users will not fit. Set up fewer users here, or manage the rest from a separate configuration. If the lock really does have more slots than that, re-interview it -- a stale or incomplete interview makes it under-report its capacity.

choose_path.description:
Some locks mask stored PINs, making them invisible to external tools. Once LCM is managing your locks, do not set codes using other tools or manually at the lock. Clear all slots before setup. For permanent access codes, configure them through LCM without a condition entity.

Choose whether you want to configure each slot via the UI or if you want to configure all slots in a YAML config.
choose_path.title: Choose Path

lock_offline.description: Lock Code Manager has been unable to communicate with `{lock_entity_id}` for multiple consecutive attempts. Code synchronization is paused until the lock is reachable again. This issue will be automatically dismissed when the lock recovers.

lock_setup_failed.title: Lock setup failed: {lock_entity_id}
lock_setup_failed.description:
Lock Code Manager could not set up `{lock_entity_id}`: {error}

Its entities are created but unavailable, and code synchronization is paused for this lock. After addressing the cause, reload the lock's integration (or Lock Code Manager) to retry. This issue will be automatically dismissed when setup succeeds.
